9460.text: But she wrote in the letters, saying: “Proclaim a fast, and HAVE Naʹboth sit at the head of the people.

9461.label: 1 Kings 21:10
9461.text: And MAKE two men, good-for-nothing fellows, sit in front of him, and let them bear witness against him, saying, ‘You have cursed God and the king!’ And BRING him out and stone him that he may die.”

9462.label: 1 Kings 21:11
9462.text: So the men of his city, the older men and the nobles that were dwelling in his city, did just as Jezʹe·bel had sent to them, just as it was written in the letters that she had sent to them.

9463.label: 1 Kings 21:12
9463.text: They proclaimed a fast and had Naʹboth sit at the head of the people.

9464.label: 1 Kings 21:13
9464.text: Then two of the men, good-for-nothing fellows, came in and sat down in front of him; and the good-for-nothing men began to bear witness against him, that is, Naʹboth, in front of the people, saying: “Naʹboth has cursed God and the king!” After that they brought him out to the outskirts of the city and stoned him with stones, so that he died.

9465.label: 1 Kings 21:14
9465.text: They now sent to Jezʹe·bel, saying: “Naʹboth has been stoned so that he is dead.”

9466.label: 1 Kings 21:15
9466.text: And it came about that, as soon as Jezʹe·bel heard that Naʹboth had been stoned so that he died, Jezʹe·bel immediately said to Aʹhab: “Rise up, take possession of the vineyard of Naʹboth the Jezʹre·el·ite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naʹboth is no longer alive, but dead.”

9467.label: 1 Kings 21:16
9467.text: And it came about that, as soon as Aʹhab heard that Naʹboth was dead, Aʹhab at once rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naʹboth the Jezʹre·el·ite, to take possession of it.

9468.label: 1 Kings 21:17
9468.text: And Jehovah’s word came to E·liʹjah the Tishʹbite, saying:

9469.label: 1 Kings 21:18
9469.text: “Rise up, go down to meet Aʹhab the king of Israel, who is in Sa·marʹi·a. There he is in the vineyard of Naʹboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

9470.label: 1 Kings 21:19
9470.text: And you must speak to him, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Have you murdered and also taken possession?”’ And you must speak to him, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naʹboth, the dogs will lick up your blood, even yours.”’”

9471.label: 1 Kings 21:20
9471.text: And Aʹhab proceeded to say to E·liʹjah: “Have you found me, O enemy of mine?” to which he said: “I have found you. ‘For the reason that you have sold yourself to do what is bad in the eyes of Jehovah,

9472.label: 1 Kings 21:21
9472.text: here I am bringing calamity upon you; and I shall certainly make a clean sweep after you and cut off from Aʹhab anyone urinating against a wall and the helpless and worthless one in Israel.

9473.label: 1 Kings 21:22
9473.text: And I shall certainly constitute your house like the house of Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat and like the house of Baʹa·sha the son of A·hiʹjah, for the offense with which you have offended and then caused Israel to sin.’

9474.label: 1 Kings 21:23
9474.text: And also as regards Jezʹe·bel Jehovah has spoken, saying, ‘The very dogs will eat up Jezʹe·bel in the plot of land of Jezʹre·el.

9475.label: 1 Kings 21:24
9475.text: Anyone of Aʹhab’s that is dying in the city the dogs will eat up; and anyone dying in the field the fowls of the heavens will eat up.

9476.label: 1 Kings 21:25
9476.text: Without exception no one has proved to be like Aʹhab, who sold himself to do what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah, whom Jezʹe·bel his wife egged on.

9477.label: 1 Kings 21:26
9477.text: And he went acting very detestably by going after the dungy idols, the same as all that the Amʹor·ites had done, whom Jehovah drove out from before the sons of Israel.’”

9478.label: 1 Kings 21:27
9478.text: And it came about that as soon as Aʹhab heard these words, he proceeded to rip his garments apart and to put sackcloth upon his flesh; and he went on a fast and kept lying down in sackcloth and walking despondently.

9479.label: 1 Kings 21:28
9479.text: And Jehovah’s word came to E·liʹjah the Tishʹbite, saying:

9480.label: 1 Kings 21:29
9480.text: “Have you seen how Aʹhab has humbled himself on my account? For the reason that he has humbled himself because of me, I shall not bring the calamity in his own days. In the days of his son I shall bring the calamity upon his house.”

9481.label: 1 Kings 22:1
9481.text: And for three years they continued dwelling without war between Syria and Israel.

9482.label: 1 Kings 22:2
9482.text: And it came about in the third year that Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah proceeded to go down to the king of Israel.

9483.label: 1 Kings 22:3
9483.text: Then the king of Israel said to his servants: “Do YOU really know that Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad belongs to us? Yet we are hesitating to take it out of the hand of the king of Syria.”

9484.label: 1 Kings 22:4
9484.text: And he went on to say to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “Will you go with me to the fight at Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad?” At this Je·hoshʹa·phat said to the king of Israel: “I am the same as you. My people are the same as your people. My horses are the same as your horses.”

9485.label: 1 Kings 22:5
9485.text: However, Je·hoshʹa·phat went on to say to the king of Israel: “Inquire, please, first of all for the word of Jehovah.”

9486.label: 1 Kings 22:6
9486.text: So the king of Israel collected the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them: “Shall I go against Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad in war, or shall I refrain?” And they began to say: “Go up, and Jehovah will give it into the king’s hand.”

9487.label: 1 Kings 22:7
9487.text: But Je·hoshʹa·phat said: “Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah still? Then let us inquire through him.”

9488.label: 1 Kings 22:8
9488.text: At that the king of Israel said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “There is still one man through whom to inquire of Jehovah; but I myself certainly hate him, for he does not prophesy good things concerning me but bad —Mi·caiʹah the son of Imʹlah.” However, Je·hoshʹa·phat said: “Do not let the king say a thing like that.”

9489.label: 1 Kings 22:9
9489.text: Accordingly the king of Israel called a certain court official and said: “Do bring Mi·caiʹah the son of Imʹlah quickly.”

9490.label: 1 Kings 22:10
9490.text: Now the king of Israel and Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah were sitting each one on his throne, clothed in garments, in the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Sa·marʹi·a; and all the prophets were acting as prophets before them.

9491.label: 1 Kings 22:11
9491.text: Then Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Che·naʹa·nah made for himself horns of iron and said: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘With these you will push the Syrians until you exterminate them.’”

9492.label: 1 Kings 22:12
9492.text: And all the other prophets were prophesying the same as that, saying: “Go up to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad and prove successful; and Jehovah will certainly give it into the king’s hand.”

9493.label: 1 Kings 22:13
9493.text: And the messenger that had gone to call Mi·caiʹah spoke to him, saying: “Look, now! The words of the prophets are unanimously of good to the king. Let your word, please, become like the word of one of them, and you must speak good.”

9494.label: 1 Kings 22:14
9494.text: But Mi·caiʹah said: “As Jehovah is living, what Jehovah will say to me, that is what I shall speak.”

9495.label: 1 Kings 22:15
9495.text: Then he came in to the king, and the king proceeded to say to him: “Mi·caiʹah, shall we go to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad in war, or shall we refrain?” At once he said to him: “Go up and prove successful; and Jehovah will certainly give it into the king’s hand.”

9496.label: 1 Kings 22:16
9496.text: At that the king said to him: “For how many times am I putting you under oath that you should not speak to me anything but truth in the name of Jehovah?”

9497.label: 1 Kings 22:17
9497.text: So he said: “I certainly see all the Israelites scattered on the mountains, like sheep that have no shepherd. And Jehovah went on to say: ‘These have no masters. Let them go back each one to his house in peace.’”

9498.label: 1 Kings 22:18
9498.text: Then the king of Israel said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “Did I not say to you, ‘He will prophesy concerning me, not good things, but bad’?”

9499.label: 1 Kings 22:19
9499.text: And he went on to say: “Therefore hear the word of Jehovah: I certainly see Jehovah sitting upon his throne and all the army of the heavens standing by him, to his right and to his left.

9500.label: 1 Kings 22:20
9500.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say, ‘Who will fool Aʹhab, that he may go up and fall at Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad?’ And this one began to say something like this, while that one was saying something like that.

9501.label: 1 Kings 22:21
9501.text: Finally a spirit came out and stood before Jehovah and said, ‘I myself shall fool him.’ At that Jehovah said to him, ‘By what means?’

9502.label: 1 Kings 22:22
9502.text: To this he said, ‘I shall go forth, and I shall certainly become a deceptive spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ So he said, ‘You will fool him, and, what is more, you will come off the winner. Go out and do that way.’

9503.label: 1 Kings 22:23
9503.text: And now here Jehovah has put a deceptive spirit into the mouth of all these prophets of yours; but Jehovah himself has spoken calamity concerning you.”

9504.label: 1 Kings 22:24
9504.text: Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Che·naʹa·nah now approached and struck Mi·caiʹah upon the cheek and said: “In just which [way] did the spirit of Jehovah pass along from me to speak with you?”

9505.label: 1 Kings 22:25
9505.text: At that Mi·caiʹah said: “Look! You are seeing [which way] on that day when you will enter the innermost chamber to hide yourself.”

9506.label: 1 Kings 22:26
9506.text: Then the king of Israel said: “Take Mi·caiʹah and turn him back to Aʹmon the chief of the city and to Joʹash the king’s son.

9507.label: 1 Kings 22:27
9507.text: And you must say, ‘This is what the king has said: “PUT this fellow in the house of detention and feed him with a reduced allowance of bread and a reduced allowance of water until I come in peace.”’”

9508.label: 1 Kings 22:28
9508.text: Upon that Mi·caiʹah said: “If you return at all in peace, Jehovah has not spoken with me.” And he added: “Hear, all YOU peoples.”

9509.label: 1 Kings 22:29
9509.text: And the king of Israel and Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah proceeded to go up to Raʹmoth-gilʹe·ad.

9510.label: 1 Kings 22:30
9510.text: The king of Israel now said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “There will be a disguising and entering into the battle [for me], but you, for your part, put on your garments.” Accordingly, the king of Israel disguised himself and entered into the battle.

9511.label: 1 Kings 22:31
9511.text: As for the king of Syria, he had commanded the thirty-two chiefs of the chariots that were his, saying: “YOU must fight, neither with the small nor the great, but with the king of Israel alone.”

9512.label: 1 Kings 22:32
9512.text: And it came about that, as soon as the chiefs of the chariots saw Je·hoshʹa·phat, they, for their part, said to themselves: “Surely it is the king of Israel.” So they turned aside against him to fight; and Je·hoshʹa·phat began to cry for aid.

9513.label: 1 Kings 22:33
9513.text: And it came about that, as soon as the chiefs of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they immediately came back from following him.

9514.label: 1 Kings 22:34
9514.text: And there was a man that bent the bow in his innocence, but he got to strike the king of Israel between the appendages and the coat of mail, so that he said to his charioteer: “Turn your hand around, and take me out from the camp, because I have been badly wounded.”

9515.label: 1 Kings 22:35
9515.text: And the battle kept rising in intensity on that day, and the king himself had to be kept in a standing position in the chariot facing the Syrians, and gradually he died in the evening; and the blood of the wound kept pouring out upon the interior of the war chariot.

9516.label: 1 Kings 22:36
9516.text: And the ringing cry began to pass through the camp about the setting of the sun, saying: “Everyone to his city, and everyone to his land!”

9517.label: 1 Kings 22:37
9517.text: Thus the king died. When he was brought to Sa·marʹi·a, then they buried the king in Sa·marʹi·a.

9518.label: 1 Kings 22:38
9518.text: And they began to wash off the war chariot by the pool of Sa·marʹi·a, and the dogs went licking up his blood (and the prostitutes themselves bathed there), according to Jehovah’s word that he had spoken.

9519.label: 1 Kings 22:39
9519.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Aʹhab and all that he did and the house of ivory that he built and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the affairs of the days of the kings of Israel?

9520.label: 1 Kings 22:40
9520.text: Finally Aʹhab lay down with his forefathers; and A·ha·ziʹah his son began to reign in place of him.

9521.label: 1 Kings 22:41
9521.text: As for Je·hoshʹa·phat the son of Aʹsa, he had become king over Judah in the fourth year of Aʹhab the king of Israel.

9522.label: 1 Kings 22:42
9522.text: Je·hoshʹa·phat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and for twenty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was A·zuʹbah the daughter of Shilʹhi.

9523.label: 1 Kings 22:43
9523.text: And he kept walking in all the way of Aʹsa his father. He did not turn aside from it, by doing what was right in the eyes of Jehovah. Only the high places themselves did not disappear. The people were still sacrificing and making sacrificial smoke on the high places.

9524.label: 1 Kings 22:44
9524.text: And Je·hoshʹa·phat kept peaceful relations with the king of Israel.

9525.label: 1 Kings 22:45
9525.text: As for the rest of the affairs of Je·hoshʹa·phat and the mightiness with which he acted and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the affairs of the days of the kings of Judah?

9526.label: 1 Kings 22:46
9526.text: And the rest of the male temple prostitutes that had been left over in the days of Aʹsa his father he cleared out from the land.

9527.label: 1 Kings 22:47
9527.text: As regards a king, there was none in Eʹdom; a deputy was king.

9528.label: 1 Kings 22:48
9528.text: Je·hoshʹa·phat, for his part, made Tarʹshish ships to go to Oʹphir for gold; but they did not go, because the ships were wrecked at Eʹzi·on-geʹber.

9529.label: 1 Kings 22:49
9529.text: It was then that A·ha·ziʹah the son of Aʹhab said to Je·hoshʹa·phat: “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships,” but Je·hoshʹa·phat did not consent.

9530.label: 1 Kings 22:50
9530.text: Finally Je·hoshʹa·phat lay down with his forefathers and was buried with his forefathers in the City of David his forefather; and Je·hoʹram his son began to reign in place of him.

9531.label: 1 Kings 22:51
9531.text: As for A·ha·ziʹah the son of Aʹhab, he became king over Israel in Sa·marʹi·a in the seventeenth year of Je·hoshʹa·phat the king of Judah, and he continued to reign over Israel for two years.

9532.label: 1 Kings 22:52
9532.text: And he kept doing what was bad in Jehovah’s eyes and went walking in the way of his father and in the way of his mother and in the way of Jer·o·boʹam the son of Neʹbat, who had caused Israel to sin.

9533.label: 1 Kings 22:53
9533.text: And he continued serving Baʹal and bowing down to him and kept offending Jehovah the God of Israel according to all that his father had done.
